title: Are You Forged.com
summary: Truth is permanent, falsehood cannot become truth just because it looks convinving. This is a tool where you can find the difference between the truth and false.
description: There is a famous shlok in Bhagwad Gita 2.16 "नासतो विद्यते भावो नाभावो विद्यते सतः।" meaning "what is unreal cannot truly exists, and what is real cannot truly cease to exist". Imagine someone creates an AI-generated fake image of a person saying something they never actually said. For a person, "Respect" is one of the most valuable things, Respect in the sense one's character, thier image, indentity, the pureness, integrity, authenticity. 'Are You Forged.com' is a site which helps someone's to conquer over their mind, thoughts, trust, believes on *what is 'Real' or 'Fake'?* A multi-model AI deepfake detection including increadilbe features like my own AI model's, Simplistic and Non-Ambigious UI.
